scenario: Simulated zero-day remote code execution vulnerability in Edge Gateway management API actively exploited in the wild.
awareness_reasoning: Technical verification confirmed vulnerable code path is reachable in customer-deployed firmware v3.1 and anomalous exploitation attempts match threat intel telemetry.
csirt_determination_basis: Main establishment where cybersecurity R&D and operational decisions are predominantly taken (Article 14(7)).

deadlines.final_report_rule: No later than 14 days after a corrective or mitigating measure is available (Article 14(2)(c)).

steps.step: Prompt Initial Assessment and Awareness Logging
steps.notes: Awareness log signed by Incident Commander within 2 hours of detection.
Affected Member States collated (DE, FR, IE, NL). Delayed dissemination requested under Reg (EU) 2026/881.

steps.step: Simulated ENISA SRP Early Warning Submission
steps.notes: Simulated submission completed 12 hours ahead of 24h statutory limit.

steps.step: Draft Article 14(8) Proportional Customer Security Advisory (CSAF 2.0)
steps.notes: Workaround instructions prepared for enterprise customers to restrict port 8443.
CVE identifier assigned, CVSS v3.1 vector calculated (9.8 Critical), sensitivity graded TLP:AMBER+STRICT.

steps.step: Simulated ENISA SRP Detailed Notification Submission
steps.notes: Simulated submission completed 14 hours ahead of 72h statutory limit.

steps.step: Security Patch Deployment and T_FIX Recording
steps.notes: Firmware hotfix v3.1.1 published with SHA-256 signatures.

steps.step: Simulated ENISA SRP 14-Day Final Report Submission
steps.notes: Final post-mortem and threat analysis submitted 5 days ahead of 14-day limit.

user_information_step: Customer advisory ADV-2026-001 distributed via authenticated portal within 30 hours of awareness.
findings: PAR and SAR delegation rota functioned with zero friction during simulated off-hours escalation.
Customer portal automated CSAF distribution requires integration with SIEM webhook in Q1 2027.
